subject: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>
Cc: security@fastpay.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff

Hi Avery — great to meet you on the call last week. We want to lock in a POC kickoff session to align success criteria, owners, and the 6-week timeline so both teams are clear on cutover criteria. Proposed attendees: AE (Ben), SE (Dev), Soojin (solutions lead), FastPay eng, FastPay procurement, FastPay security.

Three slots that work for our core team (PST):
- Wed Oct 21, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Wed Oct 21, 3:00–4:00 PM
- Thu Oct 22, 11:00–12:00 PM

Draft agenda attached (POC_agenda_v1.docx). Can you confirm which slot works for your stakeholders and whether procurement/security need a separate pre-call?

Primary asks for the kickoff:
- Confirm success criteria (latency targets, dataset slices, privacy constraints)
- Owners for test-data provisioning and network access
- Procurement checklist and onboarding lead

Thanks — we can shift if those times don't work.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: POC_agenda_v1.docx (docx)
From: Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Ali <jamal.ali@fastpay.com>, procurement@fastpay.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff

Thanks Ben — appreciate the options. Quick notes from our side:
- Jamal (cc) should handle security questions and will want to see a SOC2 or equivalent before we permit any test data access.
- Procurement (procurement@fastpay.com) will need a short list of license terms and the expected start date for billing.
- The Wed Oct 21 3:00 PM slot conflicts with an exec meeting; Thu Oct 22 11:00 AM looks safest for the core team. Can you hold that slot?

Also looping in Samira Patel (procurement lead) in my follow-up — she'll own the procurement checklist.

Avery Holmes
Director, Product Integrations — FastPay
avery.holmes@fastpay.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jamal Ali <jamal.ali@fastpay.com>, procurement@fastpay.com
Date: 2026-10-19T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff

Thanks Avery — Thu Oct 22 11:00–12:00 PT is fine on our side. I added Dev (SE) and Neha (CS/AM) to the thread so they can prep the technical runbook and customer success milestones.

I attached a short onboarding checklist (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf) that covers infra prerequisites, required IAM roles, and test-data expectations. For the kickoff I propose this 45–60 minute agenda:
- 10m introductions & scope
- 15m success criteria (you define SLOs/metrics)
- 15m technical constraints & network/IAM owners
- 10m procurement & next steps

If Jamal needs to triage security before the call, happy to schedule a 30-minute pre-call with Dev. Otherwise we can cover the high-level gating items in the kickoff and schedule a follow-up deep-dive.

Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Jamal Ali <jamal.ali@fastpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>, procurement@fastpay.com
Date: 2026-10-20T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: FastPay security pre-reqs / questionnaire

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. Before we allow any test dataset uploads we need the following items:
- Redacted SOC2 report (or summary)
- Network diagram for the environment that will access Redwood
- Details on data retention and log access for audit purposes

I've attached our questionnaire (FastPay_SEC_questionnaire.xlsx) — if you can fill sections 1–3 and return, that will speed review. If filling takes longer than 48 hours please let me know and we can scope the kickoff to non-sensitive demos first.

On the timing: Thu Oct 22 at 11 AM PT works for a kickoff focused on success criteria; for the security deep-dive let's tentatively schedule 30 minutes the following week (I can do Mon Oct 26 afternoons).

Jamal Ali
Principal Security Engineer, FastPay
Attachments: FastPay_SEC_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@fastpay.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff

Quick update — execs at Redwood pushed a priority review into our Wednesday afternoon, so our engineering lead needs to move Thu Oct 22 11:00 AM to Fri Oct 23 9:00–10:00 AM PT. Apologies for the churn.

If Friday morning is impossible for any FastPay stakeholder we can keep Thu's slot and run the kickoff without Dev present (Soojin and Ben will handle the tech high-levels; then schedule the technical deep-dive with Dev next week). Please advise which you prefer.

On procurement: Ben — can your team share a one-page summary of license terms and trial billing cadence so Samira can review before the kickoff? Neha will assemble that and drop in a shared Drive link.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Avery Holmes <avery.holmes@fastpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Ali <jamal.ali@fastpay.com>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@fastpay.com>, procurement@fastpay.com, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad: coordinating stakeholder calendars for FastPay trial kickoff

Thanks for the note — Fri Oct 23 9:00–10:00 AM PT works for our team (Samira confirmed offline). We'll accept the shifted time so Dev can attend. Attendees confirmed: Avery, Jamal (security), Samira (procurement), two FastPay engineers (Hannah Li, Marco Ruiz).

Requests before the call:
- Ben/Neha: one-pager on trial terms and expected billing start (share via Drive link)
- Soojin/Dev: short network diagram or list of firewall/IP allowlist ranges if you plan to demo with a FastPay-hosted dataset
- Ben: please send the calendar invite and attach the final kickoff agenda

I'll look out for the invite — appreciate the flexibility.

Avery Holmes
Director, Product Integrations — FastPay
